comments.note: No blocking issues. The inline comment on _shared.yaml ('# Override per-persona via `model:` field') is slightly richer than what the plan specified — it uses backtick formatting for the field name, consistent with the `cc_model: "inherit" # Defer to user's configured model` style already in the file. This is a minor quality win.

Quoting style is consistent: double-quoted values throughout the modified YAML files, matching the pre-existing convention in all 7 persona YAMLs. The single-quote recommendation in the plan applied specifically to the FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_VSCODE template string (Step 4), not to the YAML source metadata — the developer correctly applied it to the right layer.

The QA handoff note correctly flags the WP-002 undefined-fallback risk: when `...persona` is spread into buildForTarget() context, agents 3-7 will have context.model === undefined until the resolution logic is added. WP-002 must implement the fallback (`persona.model ?? sharedMeta.default_model`) before adding {{model}} to templates — rendering literal 'undefined' would be a build-time correctness failure catchable by --strict. The --strict flag in the plan's Step 6 acceptance test is the right guard.
